AccountFlowImage.description:
Bounded inert media projection; service must first call project_image.

Base64 syntax/size checks do not validate JPEG/PNG content or prove upstream
challenge provenance. The service assigns local challenge references and
generations; caller values cannot supply or replace native idCode state.
AccountFlowImage.title: AccountFlowImage

AccountFlowReference.description: Service-owned lookup selector; the handle is never an admission token.
AccountFlowReference.title: AccountFlowReference

AccountFlowView.description: Safe state projection; no raw responses or identity/session credentials.
